data_points.source_name: Derived from 신한금융투자 리서치센터 via Seoul Finance
data_points.methodology: CAGR computed from the two endpoint values stated on the fetched page: KRW 0.7tn (2019) to KRW 1.0tn (2023), 4 years. (1.0/0.7)^(1/4)-1 = 9.33%. Assumptions: both endpoints same definition and same basis (not stated by source); the 4-year span is taken from the stated years, overriding the article's contradictory '3년 사이' phrasing. Sensitivity: if the span really were 3 years the CAGR is 12.6%; both endpoints are rounded to one significant figure ('약'), so on a 0.65-0.75 to 0.95-1.05 band the rate ranges 6.1-12.7%. Range 6-13%.
data_points.notes: Historical outturn, recorded as the reality check against the same source's KRW 2.0tn 2025 projection (which would require ~41% CAGR from 2023 — a 4x acceleration off this observed trend). The gap between observed and projected is the finding here, not either number alone.
